description:
I came to overcome 55 cycles of reincarnation The protagonist, Hanbit, is kidnapped by a goddess and undergoes 55 cycles of reincarnation in this alternate world in search of a clue that might save the world of “Erport.” However, undergoing 55 cycles of reincarnation means enduring the agony of death 55 times. Tired of suffering, Hanbit confesses to the goddess that he can’t go on, and returns to his original world. 

But the game he started just to pass the time turns out to be the very world where he endured 55 cycles of reincarnation, and the deeper he delves into it, the more he realizes that the goddess’s dark conspiracy awaits him... 

Will Hanbit be able to uncover the goddess’s sinister motives?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
